phase_name: Permission Broker Production Consumption Contract Independent Verification
summary: Independently re-derived PBPC-001 v1.0 from primary source and empirically evaluated the actual, unmodified Permission Broker against the exact request shape PBPC-001 fixes for pcae push. Found one Blocking finding (B-1): approval_present=False (fixed for every push request, no v1.0 resolution mechanism) plus POL-004 (MissingHumanApprovalRule, unconditionally active on every request regardless of action_type) means every conformant push request returns HUMAN_REVIEW, which PBPC-001 itself requires to abort -- a conformant implementation could never successfully push. Falsifies PBPC-001 Section 8's 'deferred, not MVP-active' characterization of POL-004 and Section 30's no-Blocking verdict. Independently confirmed correct: dual dispatch-site/non-bypassability design, 12-entry HARD_BLOCK_REGISTRY/3-value decision vocabulary corrections (F-1/F-2), fail-closed mechanics (7 adversarial scenarios live-executed), IWC-REQ-029, AESIC independence, Runtime Enforcement orthogonality. Two further non-blocking findings recorded: Section 8 coverage-table traceability gap against the full 12-entry legacy registry; additional git push dispatch sites elsewhere in the repository outside PBPC-001's declared scope. Verdict: NOT VERIFIED -- BLOCKING CONTRACT FINDING. No src/pcae/** modification. Runtime unchanged: Observed/observe/unavailable. See docs/verification/PHASE_148C_PERMISSION_BROKER_PRODUCTION_CONSUMPTION_CONTRACT_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md for full detail. 148D not recommended; recommends 148C.1 Permission Broker Production Consumption Contract Clarification and Repair, not authorized by this document.
tests_added_or_updated: No new test file added -- this phase is verification-only per its No-Go Boundary. Existing permission_broker/push suites re-run fresh (not modified) to empirically test Finding B-1 and confirm no regression.
